deployment_checklist: 1. Run: python mycelium/WALLET_SETUP.py — generates operations wallet
3. Fund operations wallet with ~0.005 ETH on Base for gas (~$15)
4. Verify each beneficiary address on their website — set verified:true + address
5. GitHub Actions runs CRYPTO_ENGINE → auto-deploys contract
6. Contract address saved to crypto_config.json automatically
7. Store page updated with contract address → contributors can send ETH directly
